title.justification: The title is directly extracted from the title section of the paper.
title.quote: R EINFORCEMENT L EARNING WITH R ANDOM D ELAYS

analysis.description: This paper addresses the challenges faced in reinforcement learning (RL) environments with random action and observation delays, proposing a novel algorithm, Delay-Correcting Actor-Critic (DCAC), based on Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) to deal with these delays. It introduces the Random-Delay Markov Decision Processes (RDMDP) framework and applies off-policy partial trajectory resampling to improve multi-step value estimation, enhancing performance on delay-augmented RL benchmarks such as MuJoCo.

type.justification: The paper demonstrates the algorithm's effectiveness through experimental results and comparisons on benchmarks, indicating a practical empirical approach.
type.quote: This is shown theoretically and also demonstrated practically on a delay-augmented version of the MuJoCo continuous control benchmark.
